b0.text: B0 · The console frame and the audit log

howto.text:
Approved 19 Sep 2026

Each board has a Tweaks panel for its states: role, environment, notice, dialog, menu, page state, and theme (System, Day or Night). The phone boards have the same states as the desktop ones. The theme button works in Play.

The three State boards show key states side by side.

In the console, steel text uses the readable steel: outline tags and ghost buttons are #416180 by day and #b5d9fd by night.
